entities.name: Silverbeard
entities.description: One of the five legendary kirin kami of Kamigawa, representing white, who believes in mortal enlightenment.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The plane where the five kirin live.

entities.name: Pipe
entities.description: Another of the five kirin, who plays a chess-like game with Silverbeard.

entities.name: Scale
entities.description: Another kirin, who mocked Silverbeard's story and favors the extermination of mortals.

entities.name: The five kirin
entities.description: Five legendary kirin kami who meet every 1,000 years.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: The war that began as the five kirin met.

entities.name: Minamo
entities.description: The place with a painting holding the small teahouse where the kirin met.

entities.name: Reito
entities.description: Ruins that were once a lively center of commerce and learning.

entities.name: The samurai lord
entities.description: A samurai lord Silverbeard advised, ruined by a corrupt merchant, who later achieved enlightenment and became a kami.

events.summary: As the Kami War began, the five kirin met in a teahouse inside a painting in Minamo, as they do every 1,000 years.
events.quote: As the Kami War began, the five kirin met up as they do every 1,000 years.

events.summary: Silverbeard told of a samurai lord he advised, who was ruined by a corrupt merchant's schemes.
events.quote: but a corrupt merchant brought about his ruin.

events.summary: Silverbeard transformed the lord's offered helm into a tiny kami of light, secretly using his real powers.
events.quote: He transformed the helm into a tiny kami of light

events.summary: The lord gave up his title and land, joined a monastery, and became a kami at death at 88.
events.quote: In the end, the samurai lord then discarded his title and land and joined a monastery to better serve the kami.

events.summary: Scale mocked Silverbeard's story, but Silverbeard petitioned Scale to remember the time before the Kami War and still had hope for him.
events.quote: In the end, as the group was splitting he still had hope for Scale.

relations.note: One of the five legendary kirin.
relations.quote: is one of the five legendary kirin kami from Kamigawa

relations.note: Served the lord as an advisor.
relations.quote: a samurai whom Silverbeard served as an advisor

relations.note: They played a game together awaiting the others.
relations.quote: Silverbeard was one of the first to show up along with Pipe
